propwash.drone.autonomy.ended.terrain_li: %s: world edge reached – drones may not generate new terrain here
propwash.drone.autonomy.no_budget.player: %s: no further autonomous flight – at most %s per player at once (world rule “%s”)
propwash.drone.autonomy.no_budget.server: %s: no further autonomous flight – at most %s on the server at once (world rule “%s”)
propwash.drone.autonomy.no_budget.off: %s: autonomous flights are off in this world (world rule “%s” = 0)
gamerule.propwash.autonomous_flights_per: Autonomous flights per player at once

How many drones a player can have flown by add-ons without a pilot at the same time, for example for missions, follow or hold. When the budget is full, no further flight starts and the player gets a message with the value. GPS rescue without pilot has priority and always keeps one more place per player. 0 = none.
gamerule.propwash.autonomous_flights_tot: How many drones on the whole server may be flown by add-ons without a pilot at the same time. GPS rescue without pilot has priority and always keeps two more places. 0 = none.
